text:
Lucas Wetherby skippered the yacht Seren Aduial in the Pallister Cup, and he was at the helm on the final race day, 14 September 2023.

I saw the Official Crew Declaration Form (Race Ref. PC-23/09) at the Harrowmere Yacht Club registry, where it is filed. It lists Wetherby as skipper. Marguerite Ostrander, Race Director of the Pallister Cup Committee, told me she verified the crew declarations herself before the start.

Seren Aduial completed the 212-nautical-mile course in 31 hours 47 minutes. That placed her third among 18 entries.

Standing on the quay as the boat came in, I watched Wetherby step ashore to greet the shore team. The result is a strong showing for a crew that many in the club had not expected to finish so near the front of the fleet.
